'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Chris Terwilliger LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Terwilliger]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Name box on the Day 2 sheet is Chris Twigg.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
